title: xgboost-bridge artifact, format_version 1
description: Normative JSON Schema for the artifact defined in FORMAT.md. A reader raises on any unrecognized key at any level (FORMAT.md section 3, section 13), so additionalProperties is false at every level of this document rather than only at the top.

format_version.description: The version of this specification, not of the exporter or of XGBoost (FORMAT.md section 2). A reader raises on any value other than the integer 1.

objective.description: Non-operative metadata with an export-time validation role only: its sole job is the export-time cross-check against output_transform (FORMAT.md section 4, D028). No predictor, in either language, branches on this field on any prediction path -- output_transform alone determines runtime behavior.

intercept.description: The single operative numeric value a predictor reads: the margin-space intercept, already transformed, narrowed to float32 on read, and used as the accumulator's initial value before any tree is walked (FORMAT.md section 6). A predictor never applies logit, ln, exp, or any other function to this field. provenance.base_score is read by nothing -- it is retained purely for inspection (D015).

base_score.description: The raw value XGBoost stored for learner.learner_model_param.base_score, copied through with zero interpretation -- a JSON string containing a bracketed array token such as "[6E-1]", never a parsed or float32-snapped number (FORMAT.md section 16). Nothing downstream reads this field; the operative intercept is the top-level intercept field.

default_left.description: 1 routes a missing value to left_children[i]; 0 routes it to right_children[i]. Meaningless and never read at a leaf (FORMAT.md section 8).

node_values.description: One array carrying both roles XGBoost's split_conditions carries: the float32 split threshold at an internal node, the float32 leaf output at a leaf. Which role applies is never ambiguous given left_children[i] == -1 (FORMAT.md section 8.1).
